themes_detail.label: Overgrown Trees Surge
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree and branch complaints spiked to 34 THIS WEEK versus a 17.5-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 94% increase (z-score: 4.0)—coinciding with recent weather and aligning with the district's repeated budget requests for forestry services.
evidence: 34 overgrown tree/branch complaints THIS WEEK vs. 17.5 weekly average (8-week baseline)
94% spike with z-score of 4.0, indicating statistically significant anomaly
Forestry services cited in community board recurring budget requests (01 priority), suggesting long-standing unmet need
reporting_angles: Interview residents about safety hazards—fallen branches, visibility, property damage—in Tottenville and Great Kills
Investigate Parks Department response times and resource allocation for emergency tree work in this district

themes_detail.label: Rodent Complaints Up 261%
themes_detail.summary: Rodent complaints nearly quadrupled to 14 LAST WEEK compared to a 3.9-complaint weekly average (8-week baseline)—a 261% spike (z-score: 4.59)—pointing to potential sanitation breakdowns or environmental conditions in the district.
evidence: 14 rodent complaints last week vs. 3.9 weekly average (z-score: 4.59)
261% increase over 8-week baseline, flagged as high-severity spike
District has standing budget request to increase illegal dumping enforcement (source of rodent attractants)
reporting_angles: Map affected addresses and interview residents about frequency of sightings, locations, and sanitation conditions
Check Department of Sanitation missed collection and dirty condition complaint patterns (382 and 361 complaints over 90 days) to assess correlation

themes_detail.label: Industrial Waste & Illegal Dumping
themes_detail.summary: Industrial waste complaints jumped to 3 LAST WEEK from a 0.2-complaint weekly average—a 1100% spike (z-score: 6.35)—matching the district's persistent budget request for increased enforcement of illegal dumping laws, suggesting enforcement gaps or active dumping sites.
evidence: 3 industrial waste complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (8-week baseline)
1100% increase with z-score of 6.35, flagged as high-severity spike
Community board recurring budget request (01 priority) for increased enforcement of illegal dumping laws—indicates persistent problem
reporting_angles: Identify specific dumping sites and interview neighbors about environmental/health impacts
Examine Department of Sanitation enforcement records—citations, response times, repeat violators—in CD 503

themes_detail.label: Litter Basket Shortage
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket requests surged to 4 complaints TWO WEEKS AGO from a 0.4-complaint weekly average—a 967% spike (z-score: 7.49, highest on record)—suggesting severe public-space cleanliness gaps in the district.
evidence: 4 litter basket requests two weeks ago vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 7.49, highest severity score on spike list)
Paired with 'dirty condition' complaints (361 over 90 days), suggesting broader sanitation stress in public spaces
reporting_angles: Survey specific neighborhoods where basket requests clustered—parks, transit hubs, commercial strips—to document litter accumulation
Interview Department of Sanitation about basket deployment strategy and maintenance schedule in Tottenville/Great Kills

themes_detail.label: Park Rules Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Violation of park rules complaints jumped to 5 LAST WEEK from a 0.5-complaint weekly average—a 900% spike (z-score: 6.36)—indicating emerging behavioral or enforcement issues in district parks.
evidence: 5 park rules violation complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average (z-score: 6.36)
Arden Heights Woods Stream Restoration project in public review, suggesting heightened park activity or access issues
reporting_angles: Identify which parks are seeing violations and what specific rules are being broken (noise, hours, unsafe behavior)
Assess whether park access, maintenance, or enforcement is contributing—connect to Parks Department resources in this district
